summary: community.vmware deprecated vmware_cluster, vmware_cluster_drs and vmware_cluster_vcls, to be removed in community.vmware 6.0.0.
questions: What happens to vmware_cluster_drs in community.vmware 6?

answer_card.title: community.vmware: cluster modules deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `vmware_cluster`, `vmware_cluster_drs` and `vmware_cluster_vcls` are deprecated and will be removed in **community.vmware 6.0.0**. Plan to move to the `vmware.vmware` cluster modules.
